facts.fact: Jembi states that in July 2024 Mozambique launched real-time digital birth registration connecting the hospital system MGDH-Birth to the civil registration system e-SiRCEV through its OpenHIM interoperability layer, as a pilot that grew from 5 to 19 health facilities in Inhambane Province and registered over 11,589 newborns.

C-Saude reports that the laboratory information system DISA sends viral load results automatically to the patient tracking system SESP, covering all provinces with more than 500 facilities and over a million results transmitted in the past 12 months.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health with C-Saude and US Government support
systems.tiers: referral laboratories to health facilities, national

facts.fact: Jembi reports that interoperability between the civil registration system e-SiRCEV and the hospital births module MGDH-births launched on 22 July 2024, after an Inhambane Province start in April and May 2024 that takes birth-registering facilities there from five to nineteen, with nationwide expansion planned.

systems.system: e-SiRCEV (Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics System)
MGDH-births (Hospital Data Management Module for Births Registration)

systems.owner: Government of Mozambique with Jembi Health Systems and Saudigitus
systems.tiers: hospitals to civil registration, Inhambane first
